legacy_data_policy: training only; unknown game IDs explicitly retained as unknown
validation: fresh completed games assigned by deterministic game-ID hash; every first4FEN validation key excluded from all training
legacy_bestmove_filter: no legal capture/promotion/checking move; conservative because originalbestmovesmissing
schedule: linear result blend; cosine learning rate
initialization: zero residual output; optional separately reported shipped-network initialization only if justified by measured baseline
validation_metric: complete held-out pureteacher probability MSE, same labels/scale for HCE/combined/shipped/net-only
selection: initial checkpoint plus all epochs retained; best complete held-out pureteacher MSE; no selection based on trainingloss
acceptance: parity passes and held-out combined loss below HCE; report actual margin. No Elo inference; user QA owns1000-game gate.
